system.description:
The plain hunter's road: no beast at your side and no druid's magic, just the mark, the trail and the kill.

  • Read the Quarry (1st): when you mark a creature, you learn its weakest save and any Resistance or vulnerability it has, and you have Advantage on checks to recall what it is and how it fights.
  • Lone Hunter (1st): Advantage on Survival checks when you hunt or travel alone or with one companion, and on checks to read a creature's size, number and wounds from its tracks.
  • Bring Down (5th): Hunter's Tricks gain a fourth option, Bring Down: the prey makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is knocked Prone.
  • Twin Marks (10th): you may keep two creatures marked at once; Marked Prey's Advantage and Hunter's Tricks apply to either.
